name: Mem0
desc: Self-editing memory layer with user/session/agent scopes over a hybrid vector-plus-graph-plus-KV store; strong LoCoMo/LongMemEval scores.

name: Letta (formerly MemGPT)
desc: OS-inspired agent runtime where the agent self-manages tiered memory (main context as RAM, archival as disk) via memory tools and a REST API.

name: Zep
desc: Memory server for agents built on a temporal knowledge graph that tracks fact-validity windows; strong on temporal queries.

name: Graphiti
desc: Zep's framework for building real-time, temporally-aware knowledge graphs for agent memory.

name: Cognee
desc: Turns ingested data into a reasoning knowledge graph so memory improves from corrections; graph-first.

name: Memary
desc: Open-source memory layer for autonomous agents that emulates how human memory evolves over time.

name: Memobase
desc: User-profile-based long-term memory for chatbot and agent apps with time-aware user event timelines.

name: Memoripy
desc: Python memory layer with short/long-term storage, semantic clustering, decay/reinforcement, and graph associations.

name: LangMem
desc: LangChain's memory primitives for storing, recalling, and managing agent state within LangGraph workflows.

name: MemoryScope
desc: ModelScope's long-term memory library for LLM chatbots with hierarchical, time-aware memory operations.

name: Memori
desc: LLM-agnostic, agent-native memory that turns agent execution into structured persistent state; enterprise/on-prem focus.

name: MemoRAG
desc: RAG framework built on a long-memory model as a global data interface, targeting 1M-plus token tasks.

name: A-Mem
desc: Zettelkasten-inspired agentic memory that links structured knowledge notes for dynamic consolidation.

name: memonto
desc: Ontology-driven memory library that structures agent memory around a user-defined schema.

name: txtai
desc: All-in-one embeddings database for semantic search, LLM orchestration, and memory-style retrieval.

name: LlamaIndex Memory
desc: Data framework with built-in chat memory buffers, vector memory, and composable memory modules for agents.

name: LangChain / LangGraph Memory
desc: Widely used agent framework providing conversation buffers, summary memory, and state persistence/checkpointing.

name: Haystack
desc: Production LLM/RAG framework with memory and retrieval components for agent pipelines.

name: GraphRAG (Microsoft)
desc: Graph-based RAG that builds a knowledge graph from documents for structured, memory-like retrieval.

name: Qdrant
desc: High-performance open-source vector database commonly used as the embedding store for agent long-term memory.

name: Weaviate
desc: Open-source vector database with hybrid search, frequently backing semantic agent memory.

name: Milvus
desc: Scalable open-source vector database for storing and retrieving embedding-based memories.

name: Chroma
desc: Developer-friendly embedded vector database popular for prototyping agent memory.

name: FAISS
desc: Library for efficient similarity search over dense vectors, a common low-level memory index.

name: Neo4j
desc: Leading graph database used for knowledge-graph and relational agent memory.

name: FalkorDB
desc: Low-latency graph database designed for GraphRAG and agent knowledge-graph memory.

name: LoCoMo
desc: Very long-term conversational memory benchmark; 1,540 questions across single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain.

name: LongMemEval
desc: 500-question benchmark for chat-assistant long-term interactive memory across six abilities.

name: agentos-bench (BEAM)
desc: Benchmark harness bundling LongMemEval, LoCoMo, BEAM, plus cognitive-mechanism micro-benchmarks.

name: Mem0 State-of-AI-Memory report
desc: Comparative benchmark report scoring memory systems on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and BEAM with token-cost analysis.

name: MemGPT paper
desc: 'MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems', the tiered virtual-context memory idea behind Letta.

name: LoCoMo paper
desc: 'Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents', a foundational conversational-memory benchmark.

name: LongMemEval paper
desc: 'Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory'.

name: Awesome-Memory-for-Agents (papers)
desc: Curated academic collection of papers on memory for language agents.

name: Mem0 Platform
desc: Hosted managed memory API and platform (graph features gated behind a paid tier).

name: Zep Cloud
desc: Managed temporal-knowledge-graph memory service for agents and assistants.

name: Letta Cloud
desc: Hosted platform for building and running stateful, self-managing memory agents.

name: Cognee Cloud
desc: Managed offering of the Cognee knowledge-graph memory engine.

name: Graphlit
desc: Managed knowledge/memory API turning content into a searchable graph for agents.

name: Ragie
desc: Managed RAG and retrieval-memory-as-a-service for agent applications.

name: Agent Memory Techniques (notebooks)
desc: 30 runnable notebooks: buffers, vector stores, KGs, episodic/semantic memory, MemGPT, Mem0, Letta, Zep, Graphiti, LoCoMo.

name: HybridAGI
desc: Neuro-symbolic agent system combining graph-program memory with LLMs.
